title: What Is a Token?
status_note: Draft script by Claude. Not human-reviewed. Needs verification before publishing: the 'usage is often billed per token' line is general across providers; confirm wording.
learning_objective: Viewer can say that AI reads and writes small pieces of text called tokens, that a token is not exactly a word, and why tokens matter (limits, cost, speed).
analogy: A sentence is a LEGO castle that gets taken apart into bricks before AI can use it.
analogy_breaks: Tokens are not neat, equal-sized bricks, and different models split text in different ways.
actual_tech: LLMs process text as tokens: units produced by a tokenizer, which can be whole words, word fragments, punctuation or spaces. Limits (context window) and usage pricing are commonly expressed in tokens.
fact_check_notes: General concept. Needs verification before publishing: exact tokenization differs by model/provider; billing-per-token statement kept as 'many services'.
takeaway: A token is a small piece of text that AI reads and writes.

phrases.text: Hey techies! Sneha here from Zillenial Talk.
phrases.say: Hey techies! Sneha here from Zillennial Talk.

phrases.text: Quick question: does AI read words the way you do?
Imagine your sentence is a LEGO castle.
Before AI can use it, the castle gets taken apart into small bricks.

card.warn: a token is not exactly a word

phrases.text: A token can be a whole word, part of a word, or even punctuation.
Common words are often one token. Rare or long words usually get split.
So a token is not exactly a word.
Why care? Because tokens get counted.
AI can only handle so many at once. That limit is the context window, coming up next.
phrases.say: A.I. can only handle so many at once. That limit is the context window, coming up next.

phrases.text: Many AI services also charge by the token, and more tokens take more time.
phrases.say: Many A.I. services also charge by the token, and more tokens take more time.

phrases.text: Where the LEGO idea breaks: tokens aren't neat, equal bricks, and different models split text differently.
So, a token is a small piece of text that AI reads and writes.
phrases.say: So, a token is a small piece of text that A.I. reads and writes.

AI doesn't read words like you do. It reads TOKENS. 🧩
Think of your sentence as a LEGO castle taken apart into bricks. A token can be a word, part of a word, or punctuation.
Why it matters: limits, cost and speed all depend on tokens.
